summary: Iter-82 Status-Driven Refunds — end-to-end verification on PREVIEW with amasi.jewelery@gmail.com. Backend 14/14 PASS (7 review + 7 extra regression). Tamara/Tabby exact spec values match: Tamara gross=94,483.27, fees=6,419.25 (no fee on refunded), refund_full=2,648.43, net=84,452.70, refunded_orders_count=11. Tabby refund_full=352.27, net=72,804.78, refunded_orders_count=1. Per-row identity (gross - fees - vat - refund_full - refund_partial == net) holds for every gateway row. Reconciliation /api/reconciliation/summary returns expected_source='central' for tamara & tabby with expected exactly equal to central net. Refund Monitor /api/reports/refunds-alert?period=this_year returns 39 refund orders / 8,838.44 ر.س; by_payment_method surfaces تمارا (2,648.43/11), تابي (352.27/1), مدى (2,777.28/10), البطاقة الإئتمانية (1,594.71/7), دفع عند الإستلام (1,019.42/5), STC Pay (189.13/1), حوالة بنكية entries — all status-driven, no settlement file required. Frontend: Reports refunds-alert-card renders all the right rows under 'السنة الحالية' chip; refunds-view-details-btn opens the modal which shows orders with 'من حالة الطلب' badge in Source column. Accounts /accounts shows accounts-unified-gateways with Tamara net 84,452.70 and Tabby net 72,804.78. Reconciliation /reconciliation shows the same 84,452.70 / 72,804.78 as expected per platform. Cross-page consistency for Tamara=84,452.70 and Tabby=72,804.78 confirmed across Accounts ↔ Reconciliation ↔ Reports (refund part). Regression on cancelled orders verified (cancelled_orders_count populated, not summed in gross).
